```python
import pychrono as chrono
import numpy as np

# Initialize PyChrono environment
chrono.Initialize()

# Create a Chrono simulation and solver
simulation = chrono.ChSimulation()
solver = chrono.ChSolverSEulerEuler()
simulation.SetSolver(solver)

# Set up the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemSMC()
system.SetSolver(solver)
simulation.Add(system)

# Create the ground
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1000, True)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
system.Add(ground)

# Create the beam using ANCF cable elements
num_elements = 10
beam = chrono.ChCable()
beam.SetNumElements(num_elements)
beam.SetSection(chrono.ChCableSection(0.01, 0.01))  # radius, thickness
beam.SetMaterial(chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC())
beam.SetChordLength(0.1)
beam.SetNumNodesPerElement(2)
beam.SetNumBinsPerElement(1)
beam.SetNumBeadsPerBin(1)
beam.SetNumBeadsPerElement(2)
beam.SetBeadRadius(0.005)
beam.SetBeadFriction(0.5)
beam.SetYoungModulus(1e7)
beam.SetPoissonRatio(0.3)
beam.SetDensity(1000)
beam.SetRestitution(0.0)
beam.SetStaticFriction(0.5)
beam.SetDynamicFriction(0.5)
beam.SetYieldStrain(0.01)
beam.SetBreakStrain(0.02)
beam.SetStiffnessFactor(1.0)
beam.SetDampingFactor(0.01)
beam.SetBeadStiffness(1e6)
beam.SetBeadDamping(1e3)
beam.SetBeadMass(1e-3)
beam.SetBeadInertia(1e-6)
beam.SetBeadFriction(0.5)
beam.SetBeadRollingFriction(0.5)
beam.SetBeadSlidingFriction(0.5)
beam.SetBeadSpinningFriction(0.5)
beam.SetBeadStickingFriction(0.5)
beam.SetBeadSlippingFriction(0.5)
